info.title: charter
info.description: Charter turns an AI-authored, block-structured plan into a rich, reviewable deliverable a human annotates in place — the front door to the Guardrails pipeline.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Charter — visual, reviewable plans your agent drafts, annotated in place.

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert a plain Markdown document into a valid .charter.md seed (best-effort; an agent then enriches it).

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export a Charter plan (.charter.md) to one self-contained, offline HTML file.

commands.name: handoff
commands.description: Convert a reviewed Charter plan (.charter.md) to plain-CommonMark handoff markdown for Guardrails.

commands.name: poll
commands.description: Drain queued review feedback (annotations + answers) from a running review session.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render a Charter plan (.charter.md) to one portable HTML file.

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Apply a solo reviewer's queued :::question answers INLINE into the plan (single-writer-safe; via a live review server or the durable sidecar).

commands.name: review
commands.description: Serve a Charter plan (.charter.md) read-only over the loopback review server.

commands.name: skills
commands.description: Manage the Charter Claude Code skills bundled with this tool.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install the bundled Charter skills into Claude Code's skills directory.
